messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty alert — GPU pool saturation detected in gcp-europe-west6. Severity: P2. Autoscaler failing to provision new nodes due to quota errors. Start triage.

maya: Seeing queue spike on eu-west6-inference: inflight 1,180, backlog growing ~200 req/min. 95p latency climbing. UI shows many pending createInstance calls.

samir: I'm in the console. Autoscaler logs show repeated 403 QuotaExceeded on instance creation. Snippet: 
```
ERROR autoscaler: createInstanceGroup failed: quotaExceeded: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_GPU' exceeded for project redwood-prod (region europe-west6) requestId=abc-123
```

emily: Oof. Do we have cross-region capacity to failover? eu-west1 has spare pools but model shard locality might add cold-start delay.

maya: Let's throttle non-critical traffic and redirect some ratio to eu-west1. Start with 25% -> eu-west1, 75% keep in eu-west6 while we attempt quota relief. Also apply per-tenant rate limits for free-tier.

ops-bot: autoscaler: next retry scheduled in 120s. Current total GPUs requested: 4300, quota available: 0.

samir: Opening GCP support case now (case: 2024-RED-987654). Requested emergency quota increase +2000 GPUs. ETA unknown, will update. Also filing internal cloud procurement escalation.

alice: CS: Notifying top 5 paying customers (who route to eu-west6) about potential degraded performance. Draft message prepared, holding until we confirm mitigation path. @cs-team please be ready to send if latency >15s for >5% users.

emily: Rolling traffic command (example):
```sh
# route 25% traffic to eu-west1 via traffic-router
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/route \
  -d '{"from":"eu-west6","to":"eu-west1","percent":25}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_KEY'
```

maya: Also starting a temporary CPU-backed worker group to drain short jobs (embeddings, rerankers). It won't help heavy gen but will reduce queue. Samir, can you kick that off?

samir: Deploying CPU pool now:
```sh
rctl deploy --env prod --region eu-west6 --pool inference-cpu-temp --replicas 30 --image inference-cpu:2024-03-15
```
Started — expecting nodes ready in ~6m.

ops-bot: Incident update: manual traffic split applied. 25% -> eu-west1. CPU pool deployment in progress.

maya: Handoff incoming — my oncall shift ends in 18 minutes. I'll hand to patrick. Patrick, key items: support case id 2024-RED-987654, dashboard link (dashboards.redwood/prod/eu-west6/queue), mitigation: traffic split, rate limits, CPU pool.

patrick: Taking over. I'll ping infra lead for internal quota approval and coordinate with nina for cross-region cold-start. @nina can you take point with cloud contacts?

nina: On it. Engaging Google account team now, requesting an emergency soft quota bump and exploring temporary project-level allocation. Also starting cold-start of model shard in eu-west1 to reduce warmup latency — estimated 10–12m to be ready.

maya: Customer impact summary for CS: ~30% of requests experiencing >10s latency increase; <1% of requests are receiving 429s due to client retry caps. If we sustain >10% of requests over 15s for 10m, escalate to P1.

alice: Sending hold-for-approval message to customers with mitigation note. Will include expected timeline 30–45m and contact for urgent issues.

ops-bot: Incident timeline logged. Next automated update in 5m or on manual status change.

patrick: I'll own the postmortem once we stabilize. Immediate action items: 1) confirm GCP quota path, 2) monitor cpu-pool drain metrics, 3) measure eu-west1 cold-start readiness, 4) validate traffic-router success.

maya: Thanks — please keep this thread for operational updates only. If you need to pull in more folks, @pagerduty oncall or @cloud-eng. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Pagerduty: on-call handover recorded (from maya to patrick).
